title: P2 pre-T0 qualification binding (contract sections 6 and 9)
description: The S3b class-O binding: what the S3 qualification run observed at Mq, and the sha256 of the certificate it produced. This record does not exist until S3b, and its absence is a refusal — freeze_t0 reads it from git at HEAD and will not freeze a T0 without it. It binds; it does not authorize. Authority is docs/p2/OWNER_T0_AUTHORIZATION.md, which only an Owner merge can place on main.

qualification_commit.description: Mq — the commit at which the runtime-attached pre-T0 gates actually passed.

certificate_sha256.description: sha256 of the qualification certificate file as sealed. The certificate itself stays out of Git: it is a runtime artifact under artifacts/, and its bytes are pinned here.

semantic_identity_digest.description: SEMANTIC_IDENTITY(Mq). Recorded so the equivalence proof at freeze time has a value frozen at binding time to compare against, rather than recomputing both sides from whatever the tree says later.

observations.description: Class O only — observability, no trading semantics. These are observations OF a runtime, not instructions TO one, which is why they are excluded from SEMANTIC_IDENTITY.

properties_evidenced.description: The non-lifecycle operational-capability properties re-established at Mq. The lifecycle properties are NOT here: no pre-T0 record may be presented as prospective lifecycle evidence. NOTE ON THE COUNT: contract section 3 lists twelve properties and names three of them as lifecycle (paper order/fill, position state, no duplicate execution) plus the completed entry-to-realised-PnL chain, which is an aggregate rather than a thirteenth list item. Twelve minus three is nine, so the contract's 'non-lifecycle eight' and its 12/12 aggregate do not close arithmetically. The enum below carries the nine names the list actually leaves; no count is asserted here, because a schema is the wrong place to resolve a governance question. It is settled before S3, by the Owner.

t0_relation_of_every_record.description: Always T0_NOT_FROZEN. An L1 qualification record that carried any other value would be a record whose boundary did not come from the registry.

prospective_evidence.description: Always NONE. L1 proves the machinery works at the P2 commit. It proves nothing about a forward window.
